open_points.subject: A1
open_points.text: When the listing reaches an entry, one metadata reading of its path, without following a link, decides that it is a regular file and gives its listed size and modification time.
open_points.question: What must a scan do when the entry was listed but this metadata reading fails for a reason other than the file disappearing: omit the entry, report it as rejected, or refuse the scan?
options: Omit the entry as when it disappears before metadata is read
Report a rejected observation with unreadable_file
Refuse the whole scan with folder_unavailable
open_points.default_guess: Omit the entry because the scan cannot establish that it is a regular file.

witness.initial: A directory can be listed, but metadata for one visible entry cannot be read.
outcomes: The scan completes without reporting the entry.
The scan reports unreadable_file or refuses the whole operation with folder_unavailable.

open_points.subject: A3
open_points.text: Condition 2 decides A1 orders 1 and 2 from that same metadata, before the file is opened, and its other orders and conditions 3 and 4 from the opening on.
open_points.question: If the metadata size is nonzero but the opened file immediately reaches end of file with no bytes, does A1 order 1 still apply as A1 explicitly says, or may order 1 be decided only from the pre-open metadata as this passage says?
options: Apply order 1 after the empty read and return EMPTY
Do not reconsider order 1 after opening, so the empty bytes reach a later check such as the signature check
open_points.default_guess: Apply A1 order 1 after the empty read and return EMPTY.

witness.initial: A regular JPEG has a nonzero metadata size and no placement.
events: The service reads the nonzero metadata size.
Before the open, another actor truncates the file to zero bytes.
The service opens it and immediately reaches end of file.
outcomes: The delivery fails with the EMPTY member of PlacementFailure under A1's explicit empty-read rule.
The delivery does not apply order 1 because the metadata was nonzero and can instead fail with UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.

open_points.subject: A3
open_points.text: Condition 2 decides A1 orders 1 and 2 from that same metadata, before the file is opened, and its other orders and conditions 3 and 4 from the opening on.
open_points.question: For a delivered image with no camera date, is M03's file-modification instant taken from this pre-open metadata reading, from metadata of the opened file, or from a later reading, and exactly how many metadata readings does one delivery perform?
options: Reuse the single pre-open metadata reading for both size checks and file_modified
Read metadata from the opened file and use that modification time
Read the modification time again after the content has been read
open_points.default_guess: Reuse the single pre-open metadata reading and convert its modification instant to the required UTC datetime without an offset.

witness.initial: A regular image has no camera date, metadata modification time T1, and no placement.
events: The service performs the pre-open metadata reading and obtains T1.
Another actor changes only the file's modification time to T2 before or during the read.
The service prepares and places the unchanged image.
outcomes: The stored publication has photo_date T1 because the pre-open metadata is authoritative.
The stored publication has photo_date T2 because the implementation reads metadata from the opened file or reads it again.
witness.observer: The caller and anyone reading the resulting Portal photo date
